beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The aim is a revisable arrangement for living, not a perfectly defended private kingdom.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Begin with The Teacher Who Must Become Unnecessary and notice the promise it makes.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Follow the audience through the inner laboratory, social relationships, inherited practices, and AI.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The final constitution shows why those lessons belong to one argument.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its practical experiments ask readers to observe behavior and revise what fails.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book is for people seeking connection without turning their life into permanent performance.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its ending returns authority rather than asking you to reproduce the teacher’s identity.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Read it to distinguish whose judgment deserves a hearing from whose reactions have taken control.
